title: Why automated detection failed
interpretation_boundary: An automated detector returned 25 building-like candidates on the 1948 sheet. Visual review showed 24 were artifacts - letters from the MISSION VIEJO map label, red section-line dots, and a benchmark X. None of the rejected candidates is plotted anywhere in this publication.
